hints.title: Dynamic Array Storage
hints.text: Store URLs in a dynamic array with an index pointer pointing to the current active webpage.

hints.title: Forward History Invalidation
hints.text: When visit(url) is called, truncate all history following the current index before appending.

hints.title: Bound Clamping Transitions
hints.text: Clamp back and forward step offsets using max(0, curr - steps) and min(len - 1, curr + steps).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total number of visited pages
complexity.notes: Index repositioning executes in O(1) time and visit appends in amortized O(1) time when tracking logical end bound.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Two separate stacks require transferring up to K elements during repeated navigation calls.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single resizable list with an index pointer avoids auxiliary stack transfers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Array pointer arithmetic clamping boundaries within [0, size - 1].
